CHECK_USER_EMAIL_EXISTS: SELECT id FROM users WHERE email = $1
CREATE_USER: INSERT INTO users (id, name, email, password_hash, timezone) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5) RETURNING id, name, email, timezone, created_at, updated_at
FIND_ALL_USERS: SELECT id, name, email, timezone, created_at, updated_at FROM users ORDER BY created_at DESC
FIND_USER_BY_ID: SELECT id, name, email, timezone, created_at, updated_at FROM users WHERE id = $1
FIND_USER_BY_EMAIL: SELECT id, name, email, timezone, created_at, updated_at FROM users WHERE email = $1
UPDATE_USER: UPDATE users SET name = COALESCE($1, name), timezone = COALESCE($2, timezone) WHERE id = $3 RETURNING id, name, email, timezone, created_at, updated_at
FIND_USER_WITH_PASSWORD: SELECT id, name, email, password_hash, timezone, created_at, updated_at FROM users WHERE email = $1
